_what_this_settles: battle_ended is the DEFINITIVE kill signal and is strictly better than inferring a kill from the wreck. It reports reason:'victory', winning_side, and per-participant survived + kill_count. The quarry has survived:false; we have kill_count:1.

It is a PUSH event, not a reply. The poll loop sees get_battle_status; resolution still surfaces there as is_participant flipping false. battle_ended is the corroborating evidence that the flip means VICTORY rather than our own death or escape — a distinction is_participant alone cannot make.

THE SERVER ITSELF PUSHES AN INSTRUCTION TO LOOT: 'You killed a Hollow Pilgrim. A carcass dropped at gold_run_cryobelt — loot it for molt goods.' Looting is intended, designed behaviour. Brief step 8 was wrong.
That push also NAMES THE POI the carcass dropped at (gold_run_cryobelt), which is a second route to finding the wreck besides get_wrecks.
damage_taken:12 on our side. The fight was not free even against a 70-hull grazer with a starter Prospect, so the hull-abort gate is load-bearing, not decorative.
